thread:
sara_support: FYI customer acme-inc just escalated — embeddings chart shows vectors >> tokens and totals jump after nightly replay :grimacing:

mike_analytics: can you paste the screenshot and any ticket IDs? is this only for one org or many?

sara_support: attaching screenshot in the ticket (ticket #C-12481). looks like cumulative 'vectors' legend is labeled correctly but numbers are ~3x tokens for last 24h. Customer says it happened right after their replay job at ~2024-12-02T03:00Z.

mike_analytics: thx. did they run a backfill or reingest? any request_ids or event_ids we can search for?

sara_support: they provided a sample request_id: req_0a9f3b2c and an embedding_id emb_72f1e. I grabbed logs showing two ingestion events within a 30s window with same embedding_id but different kafka offsets.

raj_engineer: quick hypothesis: dedupe dedupes on event_id at ingestion, but our cumulative aggregation window for dashboard uses ingestion_time and doesn't apply the same dedupe when windows span the replay boundary. replay job replays Kafka topic -> duplicates inserted before rollup completes.

mike_analytics: can you repro with a query? if we can show duplicates in the raw events table that's useful for the customer and billing team.

raj_engineer: repro SQL I ran locally (clickhouse):
```
SELECT embedding_id, event_id, count() AS cnt
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE embedding_id IN ('emb_72f1e')
GROUP BY embedding_id, event_id
HAVING cnt > 1
```
Returned 2 rows for emb_72f1e with different event_id but same embedding_id and ingestion_timestamp within 30s.

sara_support: reproducer steps I gave customer: 1) replay topic with same payload 2) wait for dashboard rollup job 3) observe vector count jump. they sent replay command: `replay-bot replay --topic embeddings --from 1700000000 --to 1700000300 --dry-run=false`

metrics-bot: alert: embeddings-rollup-lag > 5m at 2024-12-02T03:05:12Z.

raj_engineer: root cause likely the rollup job uses `GROUP BY embedding_id, toStartOfHour(ingestion_time)` but dedupe uses event_id only at write-to-base table. When replayed messages come in with new ingestion_time they bypass the dedupe layer used by hourly rollups. We need to ensure rollup uses canonical event_id dedupe or we run a final dedupe stage before rollup.

mike_analytics: possible quick mitigation: when computing the dashboard counters, join against a deduped set using the `first_seen_event_id` materialized view. I can run a backfill to correct today's cumulative totals if we confirm.

emily_product: customer impact? possible billing disputes? they reported 62k vector units vs 21k tokens yesterday.

sara_support: yes customer asked for credit until we fix. customer is paused on production until we confirm.

raj_engineer: plan: (1) run dedupe backfill for the affected time window (03:00-04:00Z) to remove replay duplicates from rollup table; (2) add event_id-based dedupe to rollup query; (3) add unit tests for replay + rollup flows. estimate 2-3 hours for backfill + 1 day for code change.

mike_analytics: I'll run the backfill now against staging and then PROD after approval. backfill SQL (safe pattern):
```
INSERT INTO rollup_embeddings_daily
SELECT date, model, countDistinct(event_id) AS vectors
FROM embeddings_events
WHERE ingestion_time BETWEEN '2024-12-02 03:00:00' AND '2024-12-02 04:00:00'
GROUP BY date, model
ON CONFLICT (date, model) DO UPDATE SET vectors = EXCLUDED.vectors;
```
Will Snapshot and validate deltas before swap.

emily_product: please capture before/after screenshots and a short note I can send to the customer. I'll draft credit wording.

sara_support: sent a quick status to acme-inc: "we're investigating duplication in rollup after replay; will update within 3 hours."

raj_engineer: added logging to rollup job to emit `dedupe_rows` and `replayed_events_skipped`. next run will include counts.

replay-bot: replay job completed for topic embeddings (1700000000->1700000300) in 12s, 1024 messages replayed.

mike_analytics: running staging backfill now, will post results.

mike_analytics: staging backfill results: vectors decreased from 21,234 -> 7,041 after dedupe (delta -14,193). looks consistent with duplicate factor ~3x the affected window.

sara_support: customer update: they acknowledged the explanation and asked for ETA on fix + credit amount.

emily_product: propose 25% credit for the window while we fix, pending finance signoff.

raj_engineer: will PR changes to rollup to dedupe on `coalesce(event_id, embedding_id)` and add an idempotent writer. sending PR link in a sec.

mike_analytics: PROD backfill scheduled in 30m (maintenance window). will monitor dashboards and billing metrics.

sara_support: thanks all — I'll keep the customer looped in and close the ticket after verification. :thumbsup:

metrics-bot: info: rollup_job finished in 4m 12s, dedupe_rows=14,193, replayed_events_skipped=980.

emily_product: great. file a follow-up to add an integration test simulating replay -> rollup and mark as P1 for this sprint.

raj_engineer: noted. assigning task ENG-1357.

sara_support: closing thread for now, will reopen if customer sees another spike.
